purpose: Exact fail-closed authority for a future local deterministic CPU reference implementation and its checker fixtures.

effective_only_if: Every path in read_only_bundle_inputs.required_companion_artifacts exists at the bytes ratified for this successor change.
change.json, two fresh interpretations, critique.json, consensus.json, intake.state.json, and human_ratification.json exist and record an affirmative exact-byte D0-only human decision.

human_ratification.json binds the SHA-256 of every ratified companion and deliberation artifact, including this manifest; the successor change/context binds the ratification artifact. No artifact is required to contain its own hash.
The preflight entry point verifies the complete predecessor/hash chain before any output other than a terminal failure receipt is written.
authority_chain.non_implication: Proposal, consensus, ratification, implementation, passing D0, or D1 review does not authorize a model call, tokenizer execution, scientific split, GPU, LoRA, remote service, locked result, promotion, or scientific claim.
authority_chain.self_hash_circularity_rule: Paths and semantics are declared here; exact bytes are bound by the successor change/context map and human ratification. This file does not embed its own digest or peer digests.

authorized: Create and edit only the exact future source and test files enumerated in allowed_repository_writes while bringing the ratified D0 reference contract into conformance.
Execute only the two argv templates in allowed_commands from the repository root in the ratified local CPU environment.
Read only the ratified v2 inputs, the enumerated D0 source/tests, and the Python interpreter/standard-library runtime needed to execute them.
Write only the derived run directory and exact final/staging artifacts declared in allowed_run_outputs.
Freeze D0 code and receipts for fresh D1 independent review after all gates pass.
not_authorized: Changing any world, target, visibility, schema, reader, controller, compiler, estimator, claim, split, RNG, or resource contract after ratification.
Reading note 47 or any other repository file as an implementation-time fallback authority.
DEV tuning, CPU-gate instance replacement, calibration, confirmation, reserve consumption, scientific dispatch, or unmasking.
Any network, credential, remote, provider, model, tokenizer, accelerator, GPU, Metal/MPS, CUDA, training, adapter, or LoRA operation.
Vendoring or installing dependencies, invoking a shell or child process, dynamic native loading, or writing caches outside the run directory.
Promotion beyond D0, publication language, a scientific claim, or treating a fixture result as evidence about a future exact backend.
post_ratification_scope.freeze_rule: After a D0 run is submitted for D1 review, any source/test or ratified-input byte change invalidates that run. Repair requires new output lineage and fresh review; a material contract change requires a new deliberation and human ratification.

read_only_bundle_inputs.fallback_rule: A missing, extra, unreadable, unhashed, mismatched, or non-ratified authority input is a preflight failure. No older note, change, generated default, environment value, or implementation choice may fill the gap.

allowed_commands.placeholder_rule: {derived_run_id} is exactly 'd0-' plus the first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the raw bytes of human_ratification.json. No caller-selected run identifier is legal.
allowed_commands.effect: Validate authority, hashes, imports, capabilities, golden contracts, and resource measurability. It must not generate worlds from a scientific split.

allowed_commands.placeholder_rule: Both placeholders use the same deterministic run identifier defined for D0_PREFLIGHT.
allowed_commands.effect: Run the frozen 1000-step reference timing check, 64-pair CPU controller/oracle gate, all D0 property tests, and synthetic estimator/resource/claim-policy golden checks.

transitive_capability_policy.closure_rule: The preflight computes the recursive import/call capability closure of every allowed source and test entry. A forbidden capability reached directly, conditionally, lazily, through a plugin/entry point, through the standard library, or only on an error path is forbidden.

allowed_classes.description: Single-process, single-thread Python integer, Fraction, Decimal, string, collection, sorting, hashing, and explicitly ordered binary64-free checker computation.
Read raw bytes only from required ratified bundle inputs and enumerated pcfl_d0 source/test files; read interpreter and standard-library bytes only as runtime dependencies.
Create directories and atomically write only the exact derived run outputs and their deterministic staging names.

Read monotonic/process CPU time, self/child resource usage, process identity, interpreter/platform identity, and the ratified CPU power envelope; no process discovery beyond the current process family.
Use unittest to load only the exact enumerated test modules; no third-party test plugins or discovery outside pcfl_d0/tests.

allowed_dependency_policy.runtime: The .venv interpreter and Python standard library only. Importing any package from site-packages, user-site, an entry point, or a repository sibling fails preflight.
allowed_dependency_policy.native_extensions: Only native modules shipped as part of the exact ratified Python runtime may load. ctypes, cffi, custom dlopen, and package native extensions are forbidden.

forbidden_classes.disposition: fail before connection, bind, resolution, or credential lookup
fail before path lookup or load
fail before device enumeration or context creation

examples: temporary directory outside derived run root
forbidden_classes.disposition: fail closed; resolve paths without following a link outside scope

dynamic_enforcement: Network APIs are patched to raise before use and a socket-denial fixture proves the patch is active.
Imports are captured; every loaded non-bootstrap module must resolve to pcfl_d0 or the ratified standard-library runtime.
Open calls are audited against the exact read/output path sets after realpath resolution.
Process/thread creation and accelerator/model/tokenizer/training imports are trapped before side effects.
The process starts and ends with one process and one thread; any child, extra thread, open network descriptor, or out-of-scope descriptor fails.

allowed_run_outputs.existing_root_rule: The preflight may resume only byte-identical staging state for the same authority and run ID. A completed or mismatched root is never overwritten and no alternate run ID is chosen.
allowed_run_outputs.staging_rule: For each final path P, the only temporary path is root/.staging/<lowercase_sha256_of_UTF8_relative_P>.partial. A successful atomic rename removes it. Staging files are enumerated by this one-to-one derivation and may not contain an unlisted payload.

cpu_resource_ceiling.reference_execution_class: One local CPU process, one thread, no accelerator, no network, Python standard library only, on a ratified host whose certified maximum CPU package power is at most 65 W.

measurement.wall_time: time.monotonic_ns sampled immediately around each named phase; subtract start from end; a backward or unavailable counter fails.
measurement.cpu_time: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) plus RUSAGE_CHILDREN, normalized to integer microseconds; nonzero child usage fails the one-process rule even if below time ceiling.
measurement.resident_memory: resource.getrusage maximum RSS normalized to bytes (Darwin value is bytes; Linux value is multiplied by 1024); unsupported or ambiguous platform fails.
measurement.processes_threads_cores: The forbidden creation hooks and start/end current-process inspection must both report one process and one thread. One runnable thread bounds concurrent core use to one.
measurement.file_descriptors: Count descriptors owned by the current process at every phase boundary using the ratified platform probe; unsupported measurement fails.
measurement.energy: Conservative measured-duration accounting: energy_upper_bound_joules = combined_elapsed_monotonic_nanoseconds * 65 / 1000000000. The host environment receipt must certify maximum CPU package power <=65 W. Direct package/meter joules, if available without a forbidden capability, are reported as supplemental only; the pass/fail value is the conservative upper bound.
measurement.rounding: Integer ceilings are inclusive. Rational energy is compared before decimal rounding; displayed joules round upward to the next integer.

rules: Crossing or being unable to measure any hard limit terminates the phase at the next safe checker boundary and prevents a PASS receipt.
A ceiling failure is not an item-level scientific zero because D0 runs no scientific cell; it invalidates the D0 gate run.

No pair, target, seed, phase, or run replacement is legal. The same run may resume only from a byte-identical pre-dispatch checkpoint and only if the combined ceilings remain measured across the entire lineage.
Write failure.json and the resource summary if those exact writes remain safe; otherwise report the absence. Never relax a ceiling or select a different machine after seeing controller outputs.
Any 1000-step phase over 300 seconds fails even if the full-suite total remains below its ceiling.

predecessor_binding_required: fresh D1 independent verdict and advocate response
required_live_audits: all-cut masking and twin substitution from actual sealed pre-decision model states
S-life, S-bind, and T-swap outcomes on actual built corpora/adapters
future_exact_backend_reauthorization.evidence_rule: D0 fixture outputs validate only the frozen reference checkers. They are neither inherited evidence nor a substitute for rerunning these audits on every exact future backend.

fail_closed_default: Anything not expressly allowed by this manifest is forbidden.
